move: tablet lands from 3D tilt, dashboard builds, cursor switches tab, lifts away
how: A 900x640 dark-bezel iPad inside a perspective:2000px stage fromTo's rotateX 40->12, rotateY -18->-8, y 300->0, opacity 0->1 over the first 15% (expo.out), then drifts rotateX 12->6 / rotateY -8->8 with sine.inOut across 15-80%. Inside the screen, sidebar nav items slide from x:-30 with 0.06s stagger, stat cards rise from y:30 with back.out(1.7), three counters tween (onUpdate text) with power3.out, an SVG line chart draws with drawSVG 0->100% (power2.inOut) around 20-40%, and list rows stagger in from x:20. At ~43% a round cursor fades in, glides to the fifth nav item (power3.inOut), pulses scale 0.8 as a click, the nav highlight swaps colour, the h1 text changes to 'Analytics', stat cards exit up and re-enter with new counter targets. At ~91% the tablet rotates rotateX -30, y -420, opacity 0 with expo.in.
adapt: Replace the brand name, nav labels, stat labels and counter targets, list names, chart path data and accent colour (#ff5c6e); swap the stage gradient background. Keep the 1.2s expo.out landing, the 5.2s sine drift and the cursor beat timings.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the iPad DOM and the SVG chart from shot data; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same GSAP timeline with every position scaled by D/8 (landing 0-0.15D, drift to 0.8D, exit at 0.91D). Scope every selector to el and replace document.querySelector('.n1') etc. in the counter onUpdate and the tl.call() h1 text swaps with el-scoped lookups; the tl.call at 0.01 that resets the h1 text is needed for seek-back.
caveats: from() tweens on .stats .card re-entry use immediateRender:false; the earlier from() tweens rely on default immediateRender so seek order matters
text changes via tl.call() are not scrubbable backwards except via the reset call at 0.01
loop does not close: tablet exits upward and does not return
